## `neuro.uint32Array.reverse`

Instance method on `Uint32Array.prototype`.

> Reverses the elements in an Array.

## Signatures

```ts
reverse(input: { uint32Array: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<Uint32Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint32Array.prototype.reverse` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
